title: Unwavering Stance
wikitext:
{{Passive skill box|Unwavering Stance}}
{{Distinguish|Unwavering}}
'''Unwavering Stance''' is a [[keystone passive skill]] that grants guaranteed [[stun]] avoidance, but prevents the character from [[evasion|evading attacks]].

==Mechanics==
Unwavering Stance sets chance to avoid being [[stun]]ned to 100% and sets [[evasion]] chance to 0%, which means enemies will ''always'' hit regardless of their [[accuracy]] rating or chance to hit.

Unwavering Stance does ''not'' modify evasion ''rating''. This is significant mainly because of the [[Iron Reflexes]] keystone, which converts evasion rating to [[armour]]. It is therefore possible to utilize the effects of both keystones simultaneously. ([[Ghost Dance]] is also technically not affected.)

==Location==
Unwavering Stance is located on the bottom left side of the tree, on the intersection between the Marauder, Duelist, and Scion paths.
